title: exact byte conversion in UInt64 chunks
change_description: The live byte converter folds up to sixteen bytes in UInt64 chunks, using a tail-recursive prefix reader that returns the existing suffix without copying its list nodes. Exact natural-number arithmetic combines the final chunks; longer lists retain the original unbounded fold. An unconditional theorem covers every byte list. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN12-BYTE-WORDS.md).
